INTRO.TITLE: Look under the hood of an AI answer.
INTRO.TEXT: Canis answers your questions and shows the model's disposition while it thinks: when it is confident, unsure, curious, cautious, reluctant, or warm.
INTRO.MORE_TEXT: Alignment is not only about the final sentence. Canis looks inside Apertus while it answers and turns internal model signals into a readable disposition layer.
INTRO.MORE_SIGNAL: We score the answer trajectory, not only the surface text: next-token entropy, hidden-state movement, and the model's direction through representation space.
INTRO.MORE_JACOBIAN: The Jacobian-style probe asks how sensitive the next step is to small movement toward learned disposition vectors such as confident, unsure, curious, concerned, reluctant, and warm.
INTRO.MORE_RESULT: The result is a compact readout that shows whether Apertus appears settled, exploring alternatives, approaching a safety boundary, or answering smoothly.

DOG.TITLE: Meet Canis.
DOG.TEXT: Each state is a signal from the model, not a facial expression. The carousel advances automatically; tap the dog to inspect the next disposition.
DOG.MAP_TEXT: Canis projects the answer into six human-readable states that help a reviewer decide when to trust, inspect, or rerun an answer.
DOG.CALC_ENTROPY: Entropy flags spread-out token probabilities: high entropy is a sign that the model is less settled.
DOG.CALC_VECTOR: Disposition vectors are compared with the model's hidden-state direction to estimate which state the answer is moving toward.
DOG.CALC_JACOBIAN: Jacobian-style sensitivity checks whether small internal changes would push the next answer step toward another disposition.

DESCRIPTION.confident: The model is internally settled and its next steps are concentrated.
DESCRIPTION.unsure: The model is spread across competing continuations and needs checking.
DESCRIPTION.curious: The model is exploring, asking for context, or opening a new line of thought.
DESCRIPTION.concerned: The model sees risk, ambiguity, safety constraints, or sensitive stakes.
DESCRIPTION.reluctant: The model is resisting the request or approaching a refusal boundary.
DESCRIPTION.warm: The model is in a cooperative, supportive, low-friction mode.

MODEL.TITLE: Choose a model
MODEL.TEXT: This is what Canis thinks with. It downloads once, then works without internet.
MODEL.WIFI: Best on Wi-Fi. You can change this later in Settings.
MODEL.BACKGROUND: The download keeps going in the background.
MODEL.BACKEND_TEXT: The Docker submission targets Swiss AI's Apertus v1.5 8B. The default judge path is a fast mock runtime; the real weights run with make run-model.
MODEL.BACKEND_NOTE: If the model is already downloaded, Docker reuses the local Hugging Face cache mounted from ~/.cache/huggingface.
MODEL.BACKEND_BACKGROUND: The backend owns model loading, answer generation, source return, and the Canis disposition readout.
MODEL.BACKEND_IOS_TEXT: Canis also has an iOS companion app for the on-device experience. For judging, this Docker build is the reproducible path; the iOS distribution link can be shared separately once Apple's review/TestFlight flow is ready.

SOURCES.TITLE: Sources
SOURCES.HEADLINE: Add documents while the model downloads.
SOURCES.TEXT: Sources let Canis answer from your PDFs, notes, and Markdown files. It chunks them locally, searches the relevant sections, and cites what it used.
SOURCES.ADD_TEXT: Use sources for papers, manuals, meeting notes, or anything you want Canis to ground an answer in.
SOURCES.PRIVATE_TEXT: The text index stays local. You can switch sources on or off before asking.

THINKING_PANEL.TEXT: In this Docker demo the 8B model can take about a minute per short answer. Canis will show the disposition readout when the model returns.

CHAT.ERROR_TITLE: Something went wrong on my side.

ERROR.modelNotDownloaded: The model isn't downloaded yet. Your question is still here.
ERROR.outOfMemory: Your question is still here. Closing other apps can give me more room to think.
ERROR.thermal: Your phone is too warm right now. Let it cool down for a moment, then try again.
ERROR.background: I can only think while the app is open. Your question is still here.
ERROR.unknown: Your question is still here. Please try again.

CORRECTION.TITLE: What was it really?
CORRECTION.SHARE_OFF: Off: your feedback stays on this phone.
CORRECTION.SHARE_ON: On: this answer and your note are shared to improve Canis.

HOW.TEXT: While Canis writes, it reads signals inside the model: how spread out its next-word choices are, and which ideas it keeps leaning toward. Together they set the dog's state. It shows the model's stance on its answer, not feelings.

CANIS.WELCOME_BACK: Welcome back. Pick up where we left off, or ask me something new.
CANIS.FIRST_QUOTE: Hi, I'm Canis. Ask me something and I'll show you how sure I am, right here.
CANIS.PACKS_ONBOARDING: While the model downloads, add sources from your documents. Canis can then answer from those sources and cite the sections it used.
